Brownian Motion with Drift
Brownian Motion with Drift
• Let {B(t), t ≥ 0; B(0) = 0} be a Standard Brownian Motion
• Defne {X (t); t ≥ 0; X (0) = 0}
X (t)= µt + σB(t), for t ≥ 0.
µ = drift parameter
σ2 = variance parameter
Key Properties of Brownian Motion with Drift
• Independent Increments
• Var[X (t) − X (s)] ∝| t − s|
(Same as for Standard Brownian Motion µ =0, σ =1.)

Note: As∆t ↘0,ignoretermsof o(∆t).
Brownian Motion with Drift
Infnitesimal, One-Step Analysis:
• Conditional Distribution of X (t +∆t) given X (t)= x
X (t +∆t) = µ(t +∆t)+ σB(t +∆t)
= [µ t + σB(t)] + µ∆t + σ[B(t +∆t) − B(∆t)]
= X (t)+ µ∆t + σ∆B(t)
• Increment of X (·) in terms of increments ∆t and ∆B(t)
∆X = X (t +∆t) − X (t)= µ∆t + σ∆B(t)
Properties:
• E [∆X ]= µ∆t
• Var[∆X ]= σ2∆t
• Exact distribution: ∆X ∼ N(µ∆t, σ2∆t).
• As ∆t → 0
E [(∆X )2 | X (t)= x] = σ2∆t +(µ∆t)2
= σ2∆t + o(∆t).
E [(∆X )c | X (t)= x] = o(∆t) for c > 2
